summary: Sun Communities filed an 8-K on September 22, 2026, marking the closing of its previously announced sale of Park Holidays, the Company's entire UK business, to Panther Bidco Limited, an affiliate of Aermont Capital LLP. The Buyer paid approximately €772.3 million, or roughly $1.05 billion, in cash, yielding net proceeds of about $1.03 billion after closing and transaction costs. The deal was originally disclosed May 21, 2026. No board recommendation or advisor was named in the excerpt. The transaction completes Sun Communities' exit from the UK market, leaving a focus on US manufactured housing and RV properties. What to watch: management's deployment of proceeds into deleveraging or acquisitions.
